messages:
maria_support: FYI we just got a high-priority escalation from a customer (tim) — intermittent 504s and long tail timeouts hitting hosted inference. They say requests hang ~10-20s and then 504. They saw a backlog and scale-up took a long time. :warning:

deploy-bot: autoscaler event: ScaledObject 'so-tenant-42' trigger=queue-length threshold=50 cooldown=300s -> scale 0->1 triggered at 3412345690, pod scheduled at 3412345715, pod Ready at 3412345802. CPU/GPU init and model pull delaying readiness.

emma_oncall: Can you paste the scaledobject + keda annotations? Also need any gw logs (gateway 504 entries) and pod readiness logs. @raj_infra can you look? :eyes:

raj_infra: Pasting scaledobject snippet I pulled from cluster (redacted):
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: so-tenant-42
  annotations:
    autoscaling.keda.sh/cooldownPeriod: "300"    # currently very long
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: inference-deployment
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 5
  triggers:
  - type: azure-queue
    metadata:
      queueName: tenant-42-reqs
      queueLength: "50"
```

raj_infra: Looks like minReplicaCount=0 + cooldown 300s means burst requests wait while model init happens. Also noticed no prewarm hook or warmup probe.

kai_sre: Confirmed readiness probe failing during model load — readiness path returns 503 until model loaded. Model init (checkpoint pull + GPU allocation) takes ~35-45s on these machines. Combined with KEDA cooldown, we see effective scaleup of ~50-80s before Ready. That's why customer sees 504s.

maria_support: Customer wants immediate mitigation. Any quick workarounds we can apply without a deploy?

raj_infra: Short-term options:
- set minReplicaCount: 1 on scaledobject/deployment (kubectl patch).
- reduce cooldownPeriod to 30s (annotation).
- enable a small pre-warmed pool (burst capacity) or increase default kept replicas in the routing layer.

raj_infra: Example patch commands:
```bash
kubectl patch scaledobject so-tenant-42 --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicaCount":1}}'
kubectl annotate scaledobject so-tenant-42 autoscaling.keda.sh/cooldownPeriod="30" --overwrite
```

emma_oncall: If we set minReplicaCount=1 we avoid coldstart but cost increases. Get approval from finance on quick spend? For immediate test we can set minReplicaCount=1 for this tenant only.

kai_sre: Also, longer-term fix: add a warmup probe that triggers model load on pod start and return Ready earlier only when loaded OR implement a lightweight readiness that returns Ready sooner and a separate app-level ready for traffic routing. But don't change readiness without ensuring it won't take traffic prematurely.

kai_sre: Repro steps to simulate locally (so we can measure):
1) kubectl scale deploy/inference-deployment --replicas=0
2) send 60 concurrent requests via curl loop or wrk: `wrk -t4 -c60 -d20s http://gateway/tenant-42/infer`
3) watch KEDA events: `kubectl get events --namespace infra --field-selector involvedObject.name=so-tenant-42`
These reproduce the backlog -> scaleup lag -> 504 window.

maria_support: I'll update the customer with proposed mitigations (minReplicaCount=1 or route to smaller model). They asked about a routing fallback to a cheaper model variant while we fix infra — is that doable quickly?

raj_infra: Yes we can route their tenant to model-variant-small as a temporary rollback. Quick nginx patch on proxy config to rewrite model id for tenant header. Example snippet we can push: 
```nginx
map $http_x_tenant_id $override_model {
  default "";
  "tenant-42" "model-variant-small";
}
proxy_set_header X-Model $override_model;
```
I can stage that to the edge in ~10m.

tim_customer: Thanks team — fallback to smaller model sounds fine for now. Appreciate quick action.

emma_oncall: Who will run the patch? @raj_infra can you apply minReplicaCount=1 and annotate cooldown=30 for tenant-42? We'll monitor latency and error rate for 30m.

raj_infra: On it. Applying patch now. Will post results. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: kubectl patch applied at 3412345825: minReplicaCount=1; annotation cooldown=30 updated.

raj_infra: After patch: first warm pod Ready at 3412345858, gateway 504s dropped in the next minute. Monitoring metrics dashboard — request queue drains faster.

maria_support: Customer confirmed errors stopped after fallback + your patches. They said tail latency improved. Marking this as mitigated, will keep monitoring.

kai_sre: Follow-ups: open ticket to add warmupProbe + model pre-pull hook in the deployment template, revisit default KEDA cooldown for inference workloads, consider a small persistent pool for high-QPS tenants.

raj_infra: Plan: revert nginx patch after we have infra fix, keep minReplicaCount=1 for 2 hours then reassess. I'll schedule a follow-up runbook update.

maria_support: Thanks all — closing the escalation for now. :white_check_mark:
